# Reading guide

<!-- codeforge:local-only:start -->

Section 0 · Home

Parent page: [Cognitive Workspace](home.md)

<!-- codeforge:local-only:end -->

<!-- codeforge:body:start (testo scrivibile: e' la sorgente pubblicata su Confluence) seed:5f63a66211171bd1 -->
This space documents enable-spa, the web portal of e-Nable Italia for managing requests for 3D-printed prosthetic devices and for coordinating the association's volunteers. The documentation is organised in numbered sections, from context to references, and the reading paths below tell you where to begin.

- **Sponsor / association board**: start from Context and objectives (section 1), then the Architecture overview (section 3) and the chapters of the domains you care about; open points are collected in section 8.
- **Architect**: Architecture overview and the domain chapters in section 3, then the decision index (also section 3) and the interface cards in section 5.
- **Developer**: the domain chapters, the functional specifications of section 4 for the flows you are touching, and the node reference pages of section 9 for the detailed capabilities, use cases and domain concepts.
- **Operations**: section 6 (installation, configuration, runbooks) together with the Super Admin and Security chapters.
- **Test**: functional specifications (section 4) for scenarios and the traceability matrix in section 7.

Chapters of the architecture section follow a deliberate order, not an alphabetical one: cross-cutting foundations first, then the domains that build on them. No approved project plan exists yet, so the order is a proposal motivated in the plan revision log.
